about_the_game:
Duck Blitz is a fast-paced arcade shooter that invites you to ruffle some feathers in the most quacktastic way possible! Grab your trusty blaster and dive into a flurry of colorful ducks swooping in from all angles. Whether you’re a seasoned sharpshooter or brand-new to the frenzy, Duck Blitz promises nonstop thrills for everyone.

Key Features

  • Fast-Paced Action: Test your reflexes in rapid-fire rounds where ducks appear in tricky formations—stay alert or you’ll miss your shot!

  • Arcade-Style Scoring:  Chase high scores, and climb the leaderboards to become the ultimate duck hunter.

  • Easy to Pick Up, Hard to Master: Simple controls let anyone jump in, but mastering every wave will challenge even the quickest trigger finger.

  • Play Your Way:  Push your skills to the limit in time-based challenge

Jump into Duck Blitz and experience the wacky world of quacking chaos. It’s time to aim, shoot, and prove you’re the best duck wrangler around!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon RX 560 (2GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 785 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: A broadband internet connection is recommended for leaderboard or online features
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 or above
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 785 MB available space
